highlights.title: Dev mode says when it finds your code
highlights.text: Dev mode is now first in Space settings › General. When it finds a team's repo it says so, like "Found octocat/Hello-World in Web team", with Turn on Dev mode next to it.

highlights.title: A nudge in #general when a space has code
highlights.text: #general shows "Code space has code" with Turn on Dev mode, which opens the setting; nothing turns on by itself. Not now hides it for that space.

fixes: Long jobs on API engines send far less: older tool results shrink to a short note the bot can read back in full.
